item.tib: zhi ba gsas mkhar rab 'byams bder gshegs spyi 'dus kyi 'phrin las
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyig ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mo'i (mos lung) bstan nas/ lho phyogs rgyal mo tsha ba rong ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs ri nas gter la drangs te/ mdangs ldan g.yung drung gling du shog ser (bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//)
